patterns.note: Sections frequently alternate between full-width content blocks and two-column layouts, where one side features a prominent image and the other contains text or feature lists, creating a dynamic visual flow.
Headings utilize a large, bold sans-serif font for strong visual impact and hierarchy, while body text is set in a lighter weight of the same family, ensuring readability and a modern aesthetic.

The design employs a high-contrast monochrome base of white and dark grey/black for backgrounds and text, with a single vibrant teal accent color (#50E6E6) used sparingly for interactive elements, links, and key highlights.

Elements and entire sections reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they scroll into the viewport, orchestrated by GSAP, providing a smooth and engaging content loading experience. Content carousels, likely powered by Swiper, are used for testimonials and news.

A distinctive five-card grid is used immediately after the hero to present core features, each card featuring a large number, bold title, and concise description, establishing the product's value proposition upfront.

technique_notes: Uses GSAP ScrollTrigger to animate elements and sections into view as the user scrolls, typically with a staggered fade-up or subtle slide-in effect. Swiper.js is implemented for interactive content carousels, such as the testimonial and news sections, allowing users to navigate through multiple items.

The hero section features a large, centered headline and descriptive text, with a prominent call-to-action button, set against a clean, minimal background to maximize readability and focus on the core message.

Interactive elements like buttons and links consistently use the vibrant accent color for their borders or text, providing clear visual cues for user interaction against the predominantly neutral background.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual anchors, complemented by a clean, readable body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels for detail.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) are applied to buttons and cards, softening the overall aesthetic without losing a modern, crisp feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing is used throughout, with airy sections like the hero and some image-text blocks, while feature grids maintain a tighter, organized rhythm.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a bright, almost neon teal as the sole accent color against a predominantly monochrome (white, black, grey) palette creates a striking and modern visual identity. This, combined with large, impactful photography and a clean, spacious layout, elevates the brand beyond typical corporate templates.
